personality_one_liner: A precision aviation instrument tool prioritizing absolute legibility, tabular numerals, trustworthy hierarchy, and stark clinical contrast over decoration.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for forms to prevent mis-taps. Use tabular figures (SpaceMono) for all numeric inputs and outputs.

do's: Use subtle blur only for sticky headers if content scrolls behind them
dont's: Avoid heavy glassmorphism, it reduces clinical legibility and contrast.

screens.name: Calculator
screens.purpose: Input OAT, Altitude, and engine parameters to instantly view margins and PASS/FAIL verdict.

states.empty: Inputs empty, results panel showing placeholder dashes ('--')
states.error: Red banner at top explaining invalid inputs

screens.layout: Follow clinical guidelines: Keep the calculator directly on the main scrollable screen. Group inputs structurally (Environment vs Engine 1 vs Engine 2). Use 'SpaceMono' for all input fields and results. Results must update automatically and sit distinctly below the form. Wrap the final verdict in a high-contrast status container (Success/Warning/Error color) so it's instantly obvious.

screens.name: Procedure
screens.purpose: Reference official RFM operational limits and check steps.
screens.layout: Editorial-style stacked text. Use a featured hero image of the AW139 at the top (with gradient scrim). Clear typography hierarchy with bold limitations.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure clinical light theme. Avoid decorative aesthetics; focus on high-contrast, technical UI.
Implement SpaceMono or similar monospaced font for all numerical inputs, gauges, and results to ensure tabular alignment and prevent misreading.
Place the Environment inputs (OAT, Pressure Altitude) at the top, followed by two separate sections or a segmented control for Engine 1 and Engine 2 inputs.
Results must be visible on the same screen (scrollable) and compute automatically. Do not hide them behind a 'Calculate' button.
Pass/Fail indicators must be unmissable. Use the exact Success (#027A48) or Error (#D92D20) background colors for the final verdict banner with white text.
Include the safety disclaimer at the bottom of the calculator screen or as a sticky banner on first launch.
Use the provided Phosphor icon set (outlined) for UI elements.
